changes: Fixture now creates a genuinely different old version, skill and digest; the default old version is 0.0.0-fixture-old and the new version is derived from the packed package.

All cache paths use codexHome/plugins/cache/marketplace/plugin/version; remove deletes installed cache and add copies actual current marketplace source. Installed metadata is derived from that source. Omitted installedPath receipts retain real version-layout coverage.
Recovery hooks receive the old source and no longer copy from the new candidate. Original command-order, legacy, source drift, executable-bit and cache-identity assertions remain.

Added distinct-byte success and failure restoration for different-version and same-version updates, explicitly dishonest old-metadata/new-bytes restoration rejection, and strict-to-native success/failure restoration.

Added six contamination types: extra skill, root runtime file, team helper, empty directory, unlisted dangling symlink and missing required skill file. Each covers candidate, old cache, recovery source and identically polluted inputs with zero-mutation assertions; post-install rejection with restoration; and polluted rollback rejection.

Unlisted symlink negative cases target a nonexistent external path and require the inventory error rather than an ENOENT from following the link. Old cache presence and no precheck mutations are explicitly asserted.
